question: Does the recovered native task0 40k positive result reproduce under the fresh-seed current-code training checkpoint on the same registered 20 benchmark initializations?

method.compute: CPU-only summary extraction from existing remote per-rollout summary CSVs
method.comparison: Read only the success/reward/protocol columns for paired task0 rows 0..19 from the historical controlled 40k evaluation and the fresh-seed single40k evaluation. No action/state CSVs or logs were read or copied.

historical_native_task0_40k.fixed_init3_repeats: 5/5 (all 300-step-cap terminal successes per the registered review)

interpretation.supported: The current-code fresh-seed single-task checkpoint reproduces the historical 40k model's task0 success rate closely on the same 20 initializations (14/20 versus 13/20); both pass the unchanged 11/20 paired and 5/5 fixed-init3 gate. The paired discordances are balanced (3 fresh-only versus 2 historical-only; exact McNemar p=1.0).
interpretation.not_established: This is one historical/fresh checkpoint pair on previously used initializations, not held-out-init generalization or a population-level estimate across many training seeds. It does not establish deterministic replay; the historical V3 parity invalidation remains unchanged.
interpretation.progression: The single-task evidence supports the current native task0 closed-loop pipeline on this registered init set. The already-run exposure-matched 4-task model still misses task0 at 10/20, so no 8-task/Fold02 progression is justified.
